title: Timofey and cubes
statementMd:
Young Timofey has a birthday today! He got kit of $*n*$ cubes as a birthday present from his parents. Every cube has a number $*a*_{*i*}$, which is written on it. Timofey put all the cubes in a row and went to unpack other presents.

In this time, Timofey's elder brother, Dima reordered the cubes using the following rule. Suppose the cubes are numbered from $1$ to $*n*$ in their order. Dima performs several steps, on step $*i*$ he reverses the segment of cubes from $*i*$-th to $(*n* - *i* + 1)$-th. He does this while $*i* ≤ *n* - *i* + 1$.

After performing the operations Dima went away, being very proud of himself. When Timofey returned to his cubes, he understood that their order was changed. Help Timofey as fast as you can and save the holiday — restore the initial order of the cubes using information of their current location.

## Input

The first line contains single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$) — the number of cubes.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($- 10^{9} ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$), where $*a*_{*i*}$ is the number written on the $*i*$-th cube after Dima has changed their order.

## Output

Print $*n*$ integers, separated by spaces — the numbers written on the cubes in their initial order.

It can be shown that the answer is unique.

## Note

Consider the first sample.

1. At the begining row was [$2$, $3$, $9$, $6$, $7$, $1$, $4$].
2. After first operation row was [$4$, $1$, $7$, $6$, $9$, $3$, $2$].
3. After second operation row was [$4$, $3$, $9$, $6$, $7$, $1$, $2$].
4. After third operation row was [$4$, $3$, $7$, $6$, $9$, $1$, $2$].
5. At fourth operation we reverse just middle element, so nothing has changed. The final row is [$4$, $3$, $7$, $6$, $9$, $1$, $2$]. So the answer for this case is row [$2$, $3$, $9$, $6$, $7$, $1$, $4$].
statementZhMd:
年轻的 Timofey 今天过生日！父母送给他一套 $*n*$ 个方块作为生日礼物。每个方块上都写有一个数字 $*a*_{*i*}$。Timofey 将所有方块排成一行，然后去拆其他礼物了。

这时，Timofey 的哥哥 Dima 按照以下规则重新排列了方块。假设方块按照当前顺序编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$。Dima 进行了若干步操作，在第 $*i*$ 步中，他将第 $*i*$ 个方块到第 $(*n* - *i* + 1)$ 个方块组成的区间进行翻转。当 $*i* ≤ *n* - *i* + 1$ 时，他会继续进行操作。

完成操作后，Dima 得意地离开了。当 Timofey 回到方块旁时，他发现方块的顺序发生了变化。请尽快帮助 Timofey，拯救这个假日——根据方块当前的位置恢复它们的初始顺序。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$）——方块的数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$- 10^{9} ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示 Dima 改变方块顺序后，第 $*i*$ 个方块上写的数字。

## 输出格式

输出 $*n*$ 个整数，整数之间用空格分隔——方块按初始顺序排列时上面写的数字。

可以证明，答案是唯一的。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例。

1. 开始时，方块排列为 [$2$, $3$, $9$, $6$, $7$, $1$, $4$]。
2. 第一次操作后，排列为 [$4$, $1$, $7$, $6$, $9$, $3$, $2$]。
3. 第二次操作后，排列为 [$4$, $3$, $9$, $6$, $7$, $1$, $2$]。
4. 第三次操作后，排列为 [$4$, $3$, $7$, $6$, $9$, $1$, $2$]。
5. 第四次操作只翻转中间的一个元素，因此没有发生变化。最终排列为 [$4$, $3$, $7$, $6$, $9$, $1$, $2$]。因此，该测试用例的答案是排列 [$2$, $3$, $9$, $6$, $7$, $1$, $4$]。
